Designed as a recessed in‑wall media box, this enclosure provides a centralized distribution point for all your low‑voltage systems, including voice, data, audio, and video applications. Its smart design allows you to hide TV outlets, routers, cable connections, and other equipment discreetly, while still maintaining easy access when needed.
